Tutorial_Welcome:
Welcome to MuseDashTOOL! Here are some key operations you should know:

1. Some search boxes require clicking the magnifying glass to input text. Right-clicking it clears the content.
2. Page numbers in all pagination components can be clicked to enter a specific page to jump directly.
3. If you imported a background image, right-click the import button to clear it.
4. The double arrow above the left sidebar controls collapse and expansion.
Tutorial_ChartMigration: Click the toolbox and use custom chart migration to greatly speed up game startup! You can browse custom charts in-game anytime and import them whenever you want to play.
Str_AboutIntro: MuseDashTOOL is a modern, open-source utility designed for Muse Dash players. It features rapid mod management, custom chart tools, an extensive chart repository, and high-speed downloads, aiming to provide players with the ultimate, smoothest, and most premium gaming extension experience.
Str_ArtistDesc: Designer of the MuseDashTOOL icon and upload icon
Str_DisclaimerDesc: This software is released under the GPL-3.0 license and all source code is open and transparent. This utility only provides convenience for players. All chart and mod assets are obtained from free public internet sources, and all rights belong to their respective authors. Do not use for commercial purposes.
Str_AboutCommunityDesc: Join the MuseDashTOOL base camp to provide feedback, try the beta version of MuseDashTOOL, and get the author's latest custom and optimized mods. Special thanks to GreenHub for their help during the early establishment of the MuseDashTOOL repository.
